SourceTerm: 竿頭絲線從君弄，不犯清波意自殊
CreatedBy: Codex Iriya construction lane C evidence-first

Senses.PreferredTarget: play the line without disturbing the clear water
AlternateTargets: handle the fishing line while leaving the clear water untouched
the line is yours to play; the unviolated clear water is distinct
SearchAliases: play the line as you please
Senses.Note: Four complete cases preserve the paired fishing images across four independent works.

Occurrences.Kwic: 放行則恍恍惚惚，其中有物；把住則杳杳冥冥，其中有精。且道放行即是？把住即是？竿頭絲線從君弄，不犯清波意自殊。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X64/X64n1260.xml). Outline Record of the Successive Patriarchs (列祖提綱錄). Muchen Daomin asks whether releasing or holding is correct, then gives the fishing-line couplet.

Occurrences.Kwic: 天童覺云：魯祖法出好生，南泉令下詐起。天童不是檢點古人，也要諸人體悉。還會麼？竿頭絲線從君弄，不犯清波意自殊。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X67/X67n1299.xml). Classified Anthology of the Chan Grove (禪林類聚). Hongzhi Zhengjue comments on the Luzhu and Nanquan case and ends with the fishing-line couplet.

Occurrences.Kwic: 祖祖相傳事有無，休將吞吐強分疎。竿頭絲線從君弄，不犯清波意自殊。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X72/X72n1437.xml). Expanded Record of Chan Master Yongjue Yuanxian (永覺元賢禪師廣錄). Yongjue Yuanxian rejects forced sorting into having and not having before giving the couplet.

Occurrences.Kwic: 船子云：『道，道。』夾山擬開口，船子又打，夾山豁然大悟，乃點頭三下，船子云：『竿頭絲線從君弄，不犯清波意自殊。』
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J26/J26nB178.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Feiyin (費隱禪師語錄). Chuanzi Decheng speaks the couplet after Jiashan nods three times in the narrated boat encounter.

Senses.Explanation: You may play the line at the rod tip; the intent that does not disturb the clear water is naturally distinct pairs skilled handling with leaving the water unviolated. Muchen places the couplet after asking whether holding or releasing is right; Hongzhi uses it after a case comment; Yongjue places it after refusing a forced division into having and not having; and Boatman Decheng says it after striking Jiashan and seeing his three nods.
